source.citation: Bruzzese J, Doan LV. Lumbar medial branch radiofrequency neurotomy in a patient with a leadless pacemaker: a case report. Interv Pain Med. 2026;5(2):100793.
source.notes: 81M, >20 yr low back pain, right facet arthropathy; 2 sets of right MBBs 'near complete, transient' relief (no %), RFA of R L3/L4 MB + L5 dorsal ramus (read as 2 levels), 80C x 90s, 2% lidocaine; left side later: 2 sets MBB then bipolar RFA with leadless pacemaker. Fields below are null where the paper does not report them. No CMS decision exists for this patient; label left empty.
